text: Naruto Uzumaki is a determined young ninja who dreams of becoming the greatest hokage in his hidden leaf village, to earn the respect of everyone around him.
Goku spends his days training intensely to become the strongest warrior in the universe, so he can protect the earth from powerful and dangerous enemies that threaten peace.
Monkey D Luffy is the captain of the straw hat pirates who sails across the grand line with his loyal crew, to find the legendary treasure known as the One Piece.
Ichigo Kurosaki is a human who gains the powers of a soul reaper to protect his family and friends from dangerous spirits, known as hollows, that roam the world.
Eren Yeager is a brave soldier who vows to destroy all titans and free humanity from the walls that have kept them trapped in fear for over a hundred years.
Tanjiro Kamado is a kind boy who hunts demons while searching for a way to turn his sister Nezuko back into a human, after she was attacked by a demon.
Light Yagami is a brilliant student who finds a mysterious notebook and seeks to create a perfect world without crime, by acting as a god and judging criminals himself.
Edward Elric is a young alchemist who travels the world with his brother Alphonse, to find the philosopher stone and restore their bodies after a failed transmutation experiment.
Gon Freecss is a young boy who decides to become a hunter and searches for his father Ging, while exploring the dangerous and exciting world with his new friends.
Saitama is a hero for fun who trained so hard that he became too powerful, and can now defeat any opponent with just one single punch, which leaves him bored.
Ash Ketchum is a passionate trainer from Pallet Town who travels with Pikachu to catch all pokemon, and become the ultimate master in the pokemon world.
Sailor Moon is a brave magical girl who fights for love and justice every single day, to protect the earth from the forces of evil and darkness.
Izuku Midoriya was born without any powers, but he never gave up on his dream of becoming a hero, and eventually inherited the legendary quirk, One For All.
Nezuko Kamado travels inside a wooden box carried by her brother Tanjiro, to stay safe from the sunlight while they search for a way to restore her humanity.
Kakashi Hatake is a mysterious and skilled ninja from the leaf village who always hides his face with a mask, and is known as the famous copy ninja.
Roronoa Zoro is a powerful warrior who carries three swords and trains every day to become the greatest swordsman in the world, while serving as Luffy's first mate.
Natsu Dragneel is a powerful fire wizard from the fairy tail guild who can eat flames to gain incredible strength, and searches for his foster father Igneel.
Killua Zoldyck comes from a notorious family of deadly assassins, but he chooses to leave his past behind to travel and have fun with his best friend Gon.
Ryuk is a bored god of death from the shinigami realm who really loves eating red apples, and dropped his death note into the human world for amusement.
Jotaro Kujo is a tough student who possesses a powerful spirit called a stand, known as Star Platinum, which allows him to fight against dangerous supernatural enemies.
Boruto Uzumaki is the son of the seventh hokage and he wants to find his own path as a ninja instead of following in his father footsteps
Spike Spiegel is a cool space bounty hunter who travels on the bebop with his crew to catch criminals while dealing with the ghosts of his past
Kaguya Otsutsuki was the first person to ever use chakra on earth after eating the fruit of the god tree and became a powerful and feared being
Yusuke Urameshi became a spirit detective after sacrificing his life to save a young child and now protects the human world from dangerous demons and supernatural threats
Anya Forger is a young girl who has the secret psychic power to read people minds and uses it to help her fake parents with their missions
Denji is a poor young man who merged with his pet chainsaw dog Pochita to become the chainsaw man and now works for the devil hunters safety
Asta was born without any magic in a world where magic is everything but he never gave up and eventually obtained a rare five leaf clover grimoire
Rimuru Tempest died in the human world and was reborn as a powerful blue slime monster in a fantasy world where he builds a nation for monsters
Senku Ishigami is a brilliant high school student who wants to bring back civilization using the power of science after all of humanity was turned to stone
Guts is a lone mercenary known as the black swordsman who carries a very large sword called the dragonslayer and fights against terrifying demons known as apostles
Kirito is a skilled player who becomes trapped inside a virtual reality game called sword art online where he must fight to survive and escape the world
Saitama can defeat any enemy with just one single powerful punch but he feels frustrated because he can no longer find a challenge that excites his spirit
Megumin is a young arch wizard who can only use explosion magic once per day because it drains all of her mana and leaves her completely exhausted
Gon and Killua are best friends who explore the hunter world together while facing dangerous challenges and meeting new allies during their exciting journey across many lands
Sailor Mars uses her powerful fire abilities and spiritual intuition to fight against evil spirits and protect her friends alongside the other brave sailor guardians of justice
Sanji is a talented chef for the straw hat pirates who only uses his powerful legs to fight so that he can protect his valuable cooking hands
Tony Tony Chopper is a small and cute reindeer who ate a devil fruit that allows him to talk and transform into different powerful forms while healing
Nami is a talented navigator for the straw hat pirates who loves money and orange trees and dreams of drawing a complete map of the entire world
Gaara was once a lonely and feared boy but he eventually became the respected leader of his village and a loyal friend to Naruto after finding peace
Sakura Haruno is a medical ninja from the leaf village with incredible physical strength and expert healing skills which she uses to support her teammates in battle
Tanjiro Kamado uses the power of water breathing to fight against dangerous demons and protect his sister Nezuko while searching for a way to save her life
Inuyasha is a half demon who is searching for the shards of the sacred jewel while traveling with Kagome and his friends in the feudal era of japan
Kagome Higurashi fell into an old well at her family shrine and traveled back in time to a magical version of ancient japan filled with dangerous demons
Lelouch vi Britannia uses his mysterious geass power to control the minds of others as he leads a rebellion against the powerful empire of britannia to change world
Tetsuya Kuroko is a basketball player who is almost invisible on the court and uses his lack of presence to pass the ball and help his teammates
Shoyo Hinata dreams of becoming the ace of his high school volleyball team and works hard every day to overcome his short height with his incredible jumping
Tobio Kageyama is a genius setter who learns to trust his teammates and work together with Hinata to create a powerful and unstoppable attack on the volleyball court
Eren Yeager can transform into a giant titan which he uses to fight for the freedom of humanity against the terrifying enemies that threaten to destroy his world
Mikasa Ackerman is a highly skilled soldier who will always protect her friends with her incredible strength and combat skills while facing the dangerous threat of the titans
Armin Arlert uses his great intelligence and strategic thinking to solve complex problems and help his friends survive during the brutal and dangerous war against the titans
